summary: Pin the Fabric flake input from 1e6e93e9 (package version 0.9.2) to v0.9.4 (19e7f8964ce8305aeb8c200fb717967aa03f738f) for packages.fabric-pairing only; no Fractal runtime change

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes in Fractal. This change only selects the external Fabric package revision.

schema.detail: No Fractal tables, indexes, schema versions, stored formats or data rewrites change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule or digest changes.

compatibility.detail: The fabric flake input and lock move from 1e6e93e9a662a40749f91d63eeecc4e98de114bd (package version 0.9.2) to Fabric v0.9.4 at 19e7f8964ce8305aeb8c200fb717967aa03f738f. Production hosts currently run Fabric v0.9.3 (285bd482), a separate deployment baseline rather than the previous flake pin. The input's only consumer is packages.fabric-pairing; Fractal runtime code, Cargo dependencies and deployed services are unchanged.

downtime.detail: The pin does not restart or deploy Fabric or Fractal.

manual.detail: For the re-key rollout, deploy Fabric v0.9.4 on every participating member first, before deploying the Fractal re-key changes or starting any re-key.

recovery.detail: Changing this package pin writes no runtime state. It does not authorize an in-place downgrade of a Fabric daemon that has already written expiry state.
